item_name: Rothco US Space Force Patch Round With Hook Back
item_short_desc: Show your support for the United States Space Force!
description: Show your support for the United States Space Force! Rothco’s US Space Force Patch Round with Hook Back is a circular patch, measuring 3.25”. This patch features a black background, detailed with white text reading, “United States Space Force” and The Delta space force symbol. Hook backing means that this patch can be attached to any clothing or gear compatible with the hook and loop backing system.
